reviews.author: Rach
reviews.text:
Was searching for good western food stalls in the west and came across this stall with impeccably good reviews, so I had to drop by to try! Ordered the chicken chop (added pasta😊) and fish & chips— both were really delicious and sides were good too!🔥😋 Portion sizes are decent for the prices and most importantly, I really enjoyed the taste😍 Chef owner was quite friendly and approachable too. Will def be back again👍🏻🤤

Love finding good (and affordable) food places!!!

reviews.author: G Wijaya
reviews.text:
Found this hidden gem a few weeks back and can’t stop coming back. The boss is super welcoming, and every meat dish he puts out hits the spot.
The fish & chips is phenomenal: ultra-crispy batter, flaky and meaty fish, and perfectly seasoned fries. Don’t sleep on the shredded turnips either—the subtle orange-yuzu note makes it so refreshing!

reviews.author: Sebastian Lee
reviews.text: Happy to find this western food shop again after it moved from its previous location. Food is tasty and of generous portion. Would recommend the fish n chips!

reviews.author: Gabrielle Teng
reviews.text: very nice western food with generous portion, my favourite is aglio olio & fish & chips ~ uncle is very friendly! ❤️

reviews.author: Yu Wei Sho
reviews.text: I never usually leave reviews, but the food was soooo good that I felt like I had to! Tried their chicken chop for takeaway. It came well packaged, nicely dressed with crispy fries (must try, the first bite hit different) and fresh mesclun, and the chicken was tender and perfectly grilled. I could taste the chef’s craftsmanship in every bite of this dish. Decent price, generous portion, restaurant standard food, it’s really a rare gem especially at neighbourhood kopitiam. I wish I had tried this out earlier, it was definitely a 6 stars out of 5! (I was enjoying the food so much that I forgot to take a picture!)

reviews.author: Wu Chunhui
reviews.text:
The staff really patient with me and even helped me with the food. I just wanted to try my fav Korea street snacks. They were nicely price and great tasting.

Went back, and their selection of street food is excellent. Taste also good. And can get free drink.

reviews.author: Genia Wee
reviews.text: They served real authentic Korean cuisine, even local Korean residents agreed with regular patrons. Especially, their specialties braised beef ribs and 8hour simmer seollangtang, beef brisket soup, fried chicken wings, cold buckwheat noodle and kimchi ramen... are all so yummy!

reviews.author: JOLIN LEE
reviews.text:
My second try, consistent standard. Absolutely love the beef broth after my fasting. Less of seasoning can really taste the real beef bone soup which is exactly what I love.

In addition I like to add on my protein with Spicy braised chicken, the addictive mala rice cake with fish cake, and the small serving of fried chicken wing.

I can’t seem to find similar menu else where! The owner is adventurous on menu, and I must say he gain us loyal customers. Will definitely be back again to get my protein and broth fixed.

reviews.author: H26
reviews.text: Food portion and pricing are okay. Self service drinks. But it’s quite hot and stuffy to eat indoor. Perhaps can consider using solar film to block UV and reduce the temperature.

reviews.author: Seah Esther
reviews.text:
Delicious foods and nice dining ambience!
-Fried chicken fried to perfection, super crispy even with the sauce.
- Mala Tteokbokki with fish cake and melted cheese definitely will satisfy your stomach craving

Overall worth to come back again

reviews.author: Raymond Lim
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful dinner at Lerrmak / Pham Quyen Halal Vietnamese Cuisine and was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food.

We ordered the Beef Pho, Bánh Mì, and two versions of the Nasi Lemak (Vietnamese Chicken Wings and Ayam Bakar). Every dish was delicious, generously portioned and reasonably priced.

The Beef Pho came with a rich, comforting broth and tender slices of beef. The Bánh Mì was crispy on the outside, soft inside and packed with flavour. Both versions of the Nasi Lemak were excellent, and the sambal deserves a special mention - it had a great balance of spice and flavour that complemented the fragrant rice perfectly.

The drinks were equally enjoyable. The Vietnamese Iced Coffee was rich and aromatic, while the Thai Iced Milk Tea was smooth, refreshing and not overly sweet.

The restaurant is clean, comfortable and suitable for families or gatherings with friends. Prices are very reasonable for the quality and portions served.

A nice bonus is that NUS students enjoy special discounts, making it even better value.

Overall, a highly recommended place for anyone craving good halal Vietnamese food. I’ll definitely be back to try more dishes!

reviews.author: Hanseong Choi
reviews.text:
Really amazing nasi lemak! One of the best I had in Singapore so far. Chicken is perfectly crispy, the sweet and spicy kick of sambal, as well as the ikan bilis… everything just hit the spot nicely!

The seats are not very comfortable, but understandable because we’re not meant to sit there for an entire afternoon.

Service was great, the staffs are all very nice.

reviews.author: Naresh Subramaniam
reviews.text:
Ordered takeaway from the restaurant thus I have given a 5 for atmosphere since I am not in a position to comment on that. The nasi lemak is extremely average. It's not bad though, don't get me wrong. I am thankful that more ikan bilis was given as requested. The chilli was watery, a little oilier than I would have liked it to be. However it did have a sweetness that works decently well with the rice.

Something that strongly affected my experience was the strong lingering smell of fish sauce. I understand that Lerrmak shares the space with a Vietnamese restaurant thus I am sure if this issue was avoidable or not.

The overall value of the dish was maybe $9/$10 max but it was priced at $15/$16 which means that it is not of accurate value.

Hope the relevant improvements can be made. Thanks.

reviews.author: CK C
reviews.text: The Nasi Lemak rice was fragrant but was lukewarm; the chicken leg was huge but was extremely dry, almost like breast meat; the green chilli tasted only of saltiness; the egg was overcooked. This is in contrast to their Vietnamese food, which was amazingly good.

reviews.author: Hong khanh Pham
reviews.text: Enjoyed the traditional Nasi Lemak. The sambal is on point and the basmati rice is perfectly fragrant

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.text:
We recently held our academy’s anniversary event at Georges, and we’re really happy with how everything turned out.

From the planning until the actual event day, everything was easy and smooth. The team was very accommodating and made the whole experience feel relaxed and less stressful for us.

A special thank you the owner and to their team at the Cove- Mae, Red, Andrew, Raymond, and Calix for taking such good care of us and our guests. They were all very helpful, friendly, and always ready to assist whenever we needed something. Having such a supportive team really made the event much easier and less of a hassle for us.

The food catering was also excellent 100% satisfied. Our guests enjoyed it, and everything was well prepared.

The location was perfect for the kind of event we wanted. We had families, adults, and many kids with us, so the outdoor space worked really well. The beach right in front was a big plus, especially for the children who could enjoy the surroundings and play outside.

Overall, our anniversary celebration was a success, and Georges played a big part in making the day feel easy, enjoyable, and memorable.

We truly appreciate all your help and hospitality. We would definitely recommend Georges for family gatherings, celebrations, and outdoor events.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Yeo
reviews.text: Wonderful food options and drinks at affordable price. Good service in a dog friendly seaside facing setting. Good for family with children or alone relaxing and enjoying..

reviews.author: Crystal Goh
reviews.text: A really chill casual dining experience right by the waves. Very popular with the local residents and can get busy on the weekends, so always make a reservation in advance and be aware that there are likely to be surcharges on special occasions like NYE etc. The staff are friendly and it is also a pet friendly place - and I love that they always bring a bowl of water out for my pup. If you are afraid of dogs, be aware of this as there's always many doggos around. Food is decent, and I would recommend the fish and chips, fish fingers and clams in wine. They also have decent happy hour deals.

reviews.author: chang Andy
reviews.text:
Overall experience 8/10
We ordered the grilled beef: 9/10 meat is tender and juicy well prepared. The sauce came with it blend well to it.
Fish & Chip: 7/10 the meat of the fish is sweet and fresh. Portion is big
Pork chop:9/10 meat is very tender and tasty.
Top shell: 8/10 side dish appetizing
Ikan billis:8/10 nice
Hor fun: 9/10 taste good have the wok taste
Overall food is good. Recommended to try

reviews.author: hoongji
reviews.text: Great place to chill by the beach. The food is tasty. Come early if no reservation as the place gets filled up fast by 6pm on weekend.

reviews.author: KH C
reviews.text: food is very delicious.I recommend you to go with your family to this place. Anybody can get to feed the fish , but you need to pay though ($ 2.50 for a box of round fish pellets). The staff are very polite and the surroundings are very clean. The sunset looks beautiful and if you order a promfret or red snapper, you can see the person catch the fish using a hand line (hook and prawn as bait).

reviews.author: Elden Teo
reviews.text: Incredible dining experience, I highly recommend experiencing dining here at least once. The food here is fresh, although for its portion, the price can be a bit steep. Overall, the indoor seating area is well ventilated with a relaxing view overseeing the water. Just make sure you made a reservation beforehand as the place is limited to about 60 diners. Staff here were friendly. However, their service speed could use a slight improvement. Side note, they have a foosball, air hockey and pool table for customers.

reviews.author: Eddy Muhamad
reviews.text: Our first visit. We come with 10 person. Place was clean. Foods served fast as there are only 2 tables occupied. Food was delicious. Portion was generous. We can walk around the kelong while they prepare the foods.

reviews.author: Thomas Koh
reviews.text: Bring my wife here for a new experience. The staff here is very friendly and the food is very fresh for the seafood. Really have a great time here.

reviews.author: LN A
reviews.text:
We had the 7 course set. Food was fresh, good, and sufficient.

Staff is friendly, helpful and ambience is no frills. They have well-used pool, foots-all, air hockey and Jena jenga. It may be too rustic for some but my aged parents loved it.

It’s nice and relaxing to walk around the Kelong, and the old folks love lazing at the open covered deck.

They arranged ferry transport from Changi ferry terminal.

Payment by cash, PayLah or PayNow only.
